name: bench-rdp0-tzen
description: Current bench state: RDP-0, TZEN=1, bank-1 secure, WRP OFF. Not a ship profile.
status: bench — describes how a development board should look while we are still reflashing it
notes: WRP1A/1B are DISABLED here, and the encoding is the reason the fields look odd:
on STM32U5 a WRP area is off when PSTRT > PEND. 0x7F > 0x0 is 'no protection',
NOT 'protect pages 0x7F..0x0'. A profile that wrote 0x0/0x0 would silently mean
'protect page 0', which is the opposite of what a bench board wants.
SECWM1 covers the whole of bank 1 (pages 0..0x7F) because the monolithic bench
image is secure-world-only. SECWM2 is off (0x7F > 0x0) so bank 2 stays non-secure.
